source_assessment: Store.transaction preserves SafeError metadata only on the existing verified-body-rollback path; transaction acquisition and commit/rollback uncertainty paths retain their previous treatment.

OperationBoundary honors typed RecordedForgeFailure metadata only for Forge-owned bindings after verified rollback. Other owners retain reason-based behavior.

No public input schema, persistence schema, authority check, HTTP request path, provider publication or Worker deadline is changed.
